Named local repertoires include German Trinklied and Trinkspruch (university Kommerslieder, Bavarian Schunkellieder), Russian застольная (zastolnaya, "table-song"), Irish pub song / Whiskey in the Jar / The Wild Rover rep, Scottish bothy ballad rep crosses into bothy drinking song, French chansons à boire, Italian canti goliardici (medieval student drinking rep) and canzoni da osteria, Greek symposion-tradition continuing in rebetiko's drinking themes and the kafenío repertoire, Czech pijácká, Hungarian bordal, Polish biesiadne, Mexican cantina rep within rancheras, Korean jubu-ga (酒夫歌), Japanese izakaya rep including modern enka standards adopted for drinking-session use.
